🌟 trippy | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Diagnosing and analyzing network connectivity issues through an interactive terminal interface.
✨ Key Features: • Combines ping and traceroute functionality • Real-time network diagnostics • Interactive TUI (Terminal User Interface) • Cross-platform compatibility (Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD) • Multiple installation methods (cargo, package managers, binaries)
📖 Summary: Trippy is a network diagnostic tool written in Rust that combines the functionalities of ping and traceroute. It provides real-time network performance analysis and helps users identify and troubleshoot network issues through an interactive terminal user interface.
